outcome: post-operative recovery of gastrointestinal function (first flatus passage, first bowel sound, first bowel movement, defecation)
cohort: Post-partum women who underwent caesarean sections.
finding: Chewing gum is associated with a faster restoration of intestinal function after a caesarean section, leading to quicker occurrences of first flatus passage, first bowel sound, first bowel movement, and defecation, and potentially shorter hospital stays.
